name: host_admin
description: Request a server change through the root host helper (needs administrator approval), or read host status.

action.description: status reads host status now; request files host_action with host_args for approval; check reads one request by request_id.

host_action.description: request only: the change to ask for.

host_args.description: request only: file_write {path, content}; host_revert {request_id}; unit_restart {unit}; container_restart {container}; broker_install {task_id, tree_hash, allow_stale_tree?}; packages_upgrade, supervisor_update and noop {}.

request_id.description: check only: the request id a request returned.
